# Regression Modeling

Starting model (TODO: justify predictors; `units_sold` / `units_ordered` are left out
because they are measured after demand is realized).

```{r model-fit}
fit <- lm(demand ~ price + discount + promotion + competitor_pricing + epidemic +
            category + region + seasonality + weather_condition,
          data = dat)
reg_table(fit, caption = "OLS coefficient estimates")
```

```{r model-glance}
glance(fit) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, sigma, statistic, p.value, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Model fit statistics") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```
